note: Standards baseline for the HIV and TB programmes of the Adult Medicine and Medical Specialties pack. WHO publishes SMART DAKs for HIV and TB, but they are NOT vendored under docs/reference/who-dak/ (the repository vendors ANC, PNC, family planning and SMBP only), so these standards are declared by hand under the shared WHO_DAK family rather than extracted — one traceability surface, not a forked second one. Every entry cites a checkable source. The content that implements these (services/clinical-knowledge-platform-service/src/main/resources/clinical/hiv-programme-rules.json and tb-programme-rules.json) is ENGINEERING_SEED with primaryTextVendored=false: it was authored against published WHO text, not ingested from a pinned artefact, and must not be ratified until the primary text is vendored. Standards this pack has NOT yet implemented are declared here too and carried as DEFERRED in coverage-exclusions.json with the wave that will implement them, so the coverage gap is visible rather than implied by absence.
